_comment: Testimonials from partners, transcribed from the screenshots the team shared on 2026-10-09 (Drive folder 1_G7WpdNUpDFdLPipXg3_NCI9WiDt5jl8). `logo` is a file in public/partners/.

items.name: Veronica
items.quote: We have invited SVG to join Alibaba Group's multiple projects since 2020. It has been an incredibly amazing journey working with SVG and her team. As Alibaba's official marketing vendor we work with thousands of talents in the world and SVG is one of the most professional, insightful influencers. She is so into details when creating any social content. Her management team, especially Kate, is very reliable, supportive and nice to work with. We've been working with SVG for not only online social media collaborations, but also offline projects across different time zones. Whenever there is a tight schedule, they always show understanding and try to support us!

items.name: Mary Vui
items.quote: We had an exceptional experience working alongside Marina and her team. They displayed a strong commitment to their work, maintaining a high level of professionalism and diligence throughout. Their passion for what they do was evident in their handling of the project and the quality of the content they produced. In anticipation of future collaborations, we highly recommend their services to others.

items.name: Shay Levy
items.quote: Our experience working with Silicon Valley Girl and the team was outstanding. They are very devoted, professional, and hardworking. It is evident that Silicon Valley Girl has a great desire for what she does and it shows in the professional way of handling things and the content she created. We will definitely want to work with her again in the future and highly recommend others to do the same.

items.name: Martina Lovrinov
items.quote: The team of linguamarina was fantastic to work with. A true partner, they cared about our short and long term needs and objectives. They share many of the same attributes that we value at Lingoda: customer focus, the ability and sense of urgency, creativity and much more. Marina is very professional and efficient. She took part in our 3 marketing campaigns (with her both channels) and her sponsored videos brought us 180 signups in total.

items.name: Christine Colling
items.quote: We had the pleasure of working with Silicon Valley Girl for a YouTube integration, and it was a 10/10 experience. Their team's editing, script, and delivery were exactly what we requested. Marina and her team exceeded our expectations with a quick turnaround time, ensuring deliverables stayed on schedule. The team was extremely flexible, easy to work with, and accommodated all our requests. We couldn't be happier with the results and highly recommend Marina for any collaboration.

items.name: Naila Kazi
items.quote: As a company we've been working with Marina for the longest time, whether it's for influencer marketing on YouTube or short form or as a consultant guiding us in our YouTube endeavours, Marina is a true asset for any team. Her expertise and command of the topic is quite evident from her performance, but it's her professionalism and her kindness and humility that I find truly inspiring. I'd highly recommend working with her and her team!

items.name: Armine Hayrapetyan
items.quote: Silicon Valley Girl and her team's dedication and expertise made our collaboration not only productive but also a pleasure. Their passion for what they do was evident in their handling of the project and the quality of the content they produced. Throughout the project, the communication was seamless, and the transparency in the process instilled confidence in the outcomes.

items.name: Sofya Bakhta
items.quote: The Insta360 Partnerships team wants to give Marina a huge shout-out for the insightful short video workshop she presented. Her knowledge and enthusiasm clearly shone through, sparking some great discussions and inspiration. Here's to the Linguamarina team, keep rocking and smashing it!

items.name: Jack Ramsay
items.role: Social Media and PR Lead, GetResponse
items.quote: Working with Marina and her team has always been a pleasure. Punctual, creative, reliable, and ultimately, great quality content: they have all the things you want in a collaboration.
